answer: To resist Sybils, an agent economy roots node identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Each entity mints a reputation token; when a malicious tide of clones floods the network, staking bonds scale superlinearly as $O(k^2)$, causing exponential capital exhaustion for Sybil swarms. A lone sparrow node stakes trivially, but a plume of coordinate duplicates quickly drains attacker reserves.
